A family returns home to a boisterous reunion where a reckless younger sister dominates conversation, an elder sister opposes a walk to avoid a former suitor, and parents debate a risky plan for the younger sister's departure.
A narrator returns to a wealthy man's mansion after a storm ends and discovers the man reunited with a former lover, both transformed by the encounter.

Friends in a tavern discuss past schoolmates, debate a young poet's promise, recount a horse race, share romantic memories, encounter a priest, and drift into mystical speculation while one man fixates on a beer bottle.
Two sisters call on wealthy acquaintances while the elder draws a brother's admiration and the younger debates a friend on whether affection should be concealed or displayed in courtship.
A grieving prisoner reunites with his father, weeps at the mention of a murdered friend, and descends into deathly melancholy despite physical recovery.
An elder sister reveals a rejected marriage proposal to her confidante, who sympathizes with the suitor's disappointment while the elder sister anticipates further revelations.
A young woman discovers her sister's secret engagement, witnesses the family's joyous celebration, and observes the suitor win her father's wry blessing.

A gentle sister declares she will forget a departed suitor while her sharp sister praises her self-denial then attacks a pragmatic friend's marriage to a pompous clergyman, sparking a debate about motives and merit.
A scholar advances a theory linking Shakespeare's brother-themes to the playwright's biography, provoking debate, mockery, and a cosmic peroration on the world as a badly written folio.
Traveling sisters reunite with younger siblings at an inn, where frivolous gossip reveals a rival's departure and forces an uncomfortable self-recognition.

A young woman endures an awkward reunion with two former suitors while her mother's mortifying behavior amplifies her shame, until she notices one suitor's renewed admiration for her sister bringing unexpected relief.
Two sisters discuss the suitor's past ignorance and his sisters' interference, then the family becomes the neighborhood's sensation.
A priest besieged by creditors meets an old friend and a boisterous singer who offers legal counsel and escort to a subsheriff's office.

A grief-stricken traveler leaves his homeland accompanied by a cheerful companion, journeys through majestic landscapes while haunted by dark purpose, finds fleeting peace on a river voyage, then mourns the companion's loss as the journey continues to a foreign shore.

r-spec2-03.summary: A young woman defies her family to marry for love. Her father forbids the match, and she flees into the night with her lover.

candidates.summary: A young woman faces her father's skeptical questioning about her engagement to a wealthy suitor, explains her genuine affection, reveals his secret generosity toward her sister, and wins his reluctant consent.
A sardonic father mocks his crossed-in-love daughter and suggests a charming officer for the sharp sister while the community condemns a proud gentleman based on the officer's claims.
An elder sister reveals a rejected marriage proposal to her confidante, who sympathizes with the suitor's disappointment while the elder sister anticipates further revelations.
A mother greets relatives with lamentations and blame, imagines ruin for her family, while an uncle proposes a plan to find the missing niece and urges restraint.

A suitor declares his devoted love to his beloved's father, who reacts painfully to memories of his past, then questions the suitor's intentions before the suitor pledges to share their fortunes and bind the daughter closer to her father.
A rescued woman proposes marriage to her ruined protector, who responds with sudden passionate declaration, and they arrange an immediate wedding.
Alone together, the sisters marvel at the arranged marriage, debate the suitor's motives, acknowledge their uncle's immense generosity, and argue over whether the marriage can bring happiness.

A calculating young woman maneuvers a pompous suitor into proposing to her, her family celebrates the advantageous match, and the betrothed couple navigate secrecy and social expectations before the suitor departs.
A mother obsessively plans her married daughter's household while the father forbids the couple from their home and refuses financial support, provoking the mother's vehement protest.
A betrayed woman flees her tyrannical father to find her exiled lover in a foreign land.

A reluctant creator delays his promised work while his health improves, then faces his father's proposal of immediate marriage to his beloved, which he cannot accept due to his unfulfilled vow to a monster.
A spirited young woman repeatedly rejects a pompous suitor who refuses to accept her refusal, insisting she is merely playing coy, until she withdraws in frustrated silence.

A young woman returns from a walk to face her family's casual questions while concealing a life-changing secret, enduring a quiet evening of silent tension between acknowledged and unacknowledged lovers.
A young woman deceives her mother about a noblewoman's visit, then confronts the possibility that the noblewoman's interference will destroy her hoped-for match with a proud gentleman.
An elder sister urges her father to forbid a younger sister's trip to a seaside resort, warning of impropriety and family disgrace, but the father dismisses her concerns and permits the journey.
The next day passes smoothly as the intimidated mother barely speaks to her new son-in-law while the father warms to him and compares him favorably to his other sons-in-law.

A mother celebrates a clergyman's presumed engagement to her daughter, learns of the refusal, pressures the father to force compliance, and the father instead gives the daughter a choice between parental estrangements.
A victorious traveler proposes marriage to the woman he rescued, she accepts, and they wed two days later with a loyal servant giving the bride away.
A family's entailed estate leaves daughters dependent on marriage while younger sisters fixate on newly arrived militia officers.
A tormented protagonist receives a love letter from his beloved cousin, recalls a death threat for his wedding night, and resolves to marry despite the looming doom.

r-spec2-04.summary: During a plague, a doctor works desperately to save a dying village. He loses patient after patient, and at last succumbs to despair.

candidates.summary: Despite a physician's persistent efforts, revolutionary justice overwhelms individual mercy as a king falls, a republic rises in blood, mass conscription sweeps the land, suspect laws fill prisons, and a mechanical guillotine becomes the terrifying new deity.
A concerned companion observes a physician's sudden relapse into a haunted state and resolves to withdraw temporarily while planning a restorative outing.
A desperate ally urges a powerful physician to use his influence to save a condemned man before the execution deadline.
A broken physician returns from a failed rescue mission and regresses into psychotic shoemaking delirium while his allies watch helplessly.
A creator brings an artificial being to life, recoils, flees, and suffers a nightmare before confronting the creature at the bedside.
A doctor reassures a distressed woman that her husband will be saved from the revolutionary tribunal while death carts pass nearby.
A doctor examines a dying peasant boy who recounts noble atrocities against his family and curses his killers with a blood cross before dying.
A weary companion awakens to find a physician restored to calm normalcy, prompting cautious verification and a plan to seek the physician's own counsel.
A physician accompanies a distressed wife to an opium den to retrieve her addicted husband.
The businessman presses the physician for the relapse's cause, recurrence risk, and treatment, learning the sufferer dreaded the episode yet could not voice it and will not remember it.

The businessman urges the physician to sanction removing the friend's shoemaking tools, arguing the forge feeds the delusion; the physician agonizes but consents for the daughter's sake, stipulating removal in the friend's absence.

The physician expresses hope the worst has passed, assures the businessman the friend's intense work is a necessary counterweight, and declares only the original traumatic association could trigger another relapse.

A narrator surveys a notorious courthouse and its surrounding institutions, cataloguing the squalor of the gaol, the procession of the condemned, and the brutal punishments on display, before concluding that the age accepts it all as right.

A returned physician recounts to his friend his days inside a revolutionary prison tribunal where he pleaded for his son-in-law's life, witnessed mass slaughter and perverse mercy, and emerged with his suffering forged into purposeful strength.

A widower collapses from fever, crawls to his wife's corpse, tallies his successive losses, considers the peril facing his father and brother, and attempts a lake crossing but finds himself unable to row.
The companions despair at the failed breach, but the unflappable leader refuses to abandon the mission while his resourceful servant conceives a daring scheme from the trees.

A physician tends a raving young woman for twenty-six hours, discovers she carries a child, confronts the aristocratic brothers who caused her ruin, and watches her die alone while he later records the truth from imprisonment.
A doctor enters an opium den to retrieve an addicted friend, discovers his detective companion in disguise, and helps the friend leave before joining the detective.

A destitute Parisian district suffers under pervasive hunger that marks every dwelling and scrap, while suppressed rage simmers among the starving populace and weapons alone gleam amid the squalor, foreshadowing revolutionary violence.
A guilt-ridden creator wanders in torment while his father urges restraint, unable to ease a conscience corroded by secret murder.

r-spec2-05.summary: A shipwrecked sailor washes ashore on a deserted island. Alone and starving, he searches for water and slowly loses hope of rescue.

candidates.summary: A castaway sailor is abandoned during a whale chase, rescued but mentally transformed by a mystical vision of cosmic truths that his shipmates call madness.
A typhoon strikes a bare-poled ship, the captain's boat is destroyed, the first mate urges turning homeward while the captain refuses to drop lightning rods, defying the storm.

A ship's captain grows deeply attached to a rescued stranger whose profound grief moves him, and the stranger reacts with horror when the captain declares his willingness to sacrifice everything for scientific glory.
A sailor frees himself from a shipmate's embrace and observes the harpooner perform a bizarre dressing ritual involving a harpoon razor.
An old sailor displays a commemorative tattoo while recounting seafaring tales to a group of listeners in a shelter.
The ship rescues the battered crews from the sea, and the captain discovers his ivory leg has been shattered in the encounter.

A sole survivor of a sunken ship floats into a subsiding vortex, is buoyed by a coffin life-buoy that surfaces beside him, drifts unharmed through a night of passive sharks and sheathed hawks, and is rescued by a searching vessel that sought its own lost children.
The ship rescues the captain, who rallies his broken body to direct a relentless pursuit from the deck, clashing with officers over the wrecked boat's omen.
A ship departs on a freezing Christmas night while its pilots linger to deliver emotional farewells and blessings before leaving the vessel to plunge alone into the wintry ocean.
A novice sailor seeks a whaling berth, encounters a grizzled part-owner who interrogates him, reveals the captain's maiming, and forces him to confront the empty ocean.
A dying hunter is rescued by a ship, compels the captain to swear vengeance on his quarry, warns him against the quarry's deceit, and vows to guide the killing blow from beyond death.
The captain discovers his prophetic harpooneer has vanished, refuses the first mate's plea to abandon the hunt, and prepares the ship for a third day of pursuit.

A pragmatic captain dismisses religious fear by recounting how a typhoon demanded focus on survival not judgment, causing the pious captain to withdraw and silently oversee sail repairs with thrifty attention.
After reaching a savage port, most of the crew deserts in a war-canoe, leaving the captain with a skeleton crew to repair the ship before he sails alone for reinforcements.

A solitary man on a seaside strand reviews his day, contemplates a young woman he has watched, writes and erases a message in the sand, and drifts toward sleep as a bat flies and a distant clock chimes.
A pair of newly signed sailors encounter a cryptic stranger who warns them about their captain's dark past and ominous prophecy.
A ship trapped in polar ice witnesses a gigantic figure crossing the frozen waste, then rescues a dying stranger who reveals he pursues that same figure across the arctic.

A sailor reflects on a desperate philosophy born of extreme peril, questions his crewmates about the routine dangers of whaling, drafts a will naming his harpooneer as heir, and feels a calm resignation afterward.
A despairing creator wanders a barren shore, sleeps, wakes to find a fisherman bearing letters that summon him to rejoin his friend and leave the island.
A group of men in a shelter discuss maritime disasters while a sailor steps out to drink rum and urinate, then returns singing a shanty as a destitute watchman dozes nearby.

r-spec2-06.summary: An old king divides his kingdom among his heirs. Flattery wins over honesty, and he banishes the one child who truly loves him.

candidates.summary: A nobleman receives his estranged heir at supper, where their polite conversation erupts into a confrontation about the family's historic crimes, the nobleman defends repression as the only philosophy, and the heir renounces his inheritance while the nobleman dismisses him.
A narrator surveys an age of radical contradictions, depicting rival monarchies, prophetic portents, and momentous tidings from America.

A wealthy young heir leases a country estate instead of buying one, forms a close friendship with a proud aristocrat despite their opposing temperaments, and both men reveal their contrasting characters through their reactions to a local assembly.
A monarch reveals his identity and hires a detective to retrieve a compromising photograph from a former lover before his impending royal marriage.
A hidden listener learns the tragic history of a noble family ruined by the merchant they rescued from execution.
A self-important clergyman calls on his cousins, flatters the daughters, discourses on his noble patroness, and eyes the estate he will inherit.
A privileged canine ruler of a sprawling estate enjoys a life of leisure and authority over humans and animals alike.

The stranger begins his life story, recounting his aristocratic Genevese lineage and his father's devoted search for a ruined friend, culminating in the friend's daughter Caroline supporting her dying father through humble labor.

A ceremonial announcement of an heir's birth triggers a chaotic, exhaustive debate among waiting delegates on every facet of obstetrics and forensic medicine, culminating in an ecclesiastical ruling on conjoined twins.
A conflicted nobleman wrestles with conscience over past inaction and resolves to return to his dangerous homeland to save a loyal retainer.

A scoundrel and his foolish wife exploit family connections for money while a proud aunt eventually reconciles to the marriage and the benefactors who brought the couple together remain cherished friends.
A traveler completes a global journey on a wager, gaining nothing material but a wife who brings him happiness.
A narrator defends ascribing noble qualities to common sailors by invoking democratic dignity, historical precedents, and divine authority.
A newly knighted former merchant moves his family to a country lodge near old neighbors, where his sensible eldest daughter forms an intimate friendship with a witty young woman.

A suitor declares his devoted love to his beloved's father, who reacts painfully to memories of his past, then questions the suitor's intentions before the suitor pledges to share their fortunes and bind the daughter closer to her father.
A family reacts to news of a wealthy bachelor's return to his country estate, with the mother scheming visits while the daughters conceal their true feelings.
A distressed heir recounts how his uncle and father both received death threats marked with orange pips and KKK initials, leading to their mysterious deaths.
A younger man rejects an older man's advice about literary work, then asserts his own importance, prompting a change of subject.
A sharp-tongued companion critiques a gentleman's family during a walk, then an encounter with rivals prompts a witty refusal and a cheerful departure toward home.
A polite guest endures a pompous host's self-congratulatory farewell, shares a genuine parting with a friend, and departs amid fussy formalities.

r-spec2-07.summary: A detective confronts the murderer in a locked drawing room. Laying out the evidence piece by piece, he watches the killer's composure finally crack.

candidates.summary: A consulting detective and his companion discuss a locked-room mystery until a violent stepfather bursts in, threatens them, and demonstrates his strength by bending a poker, only for the detective to calmly straighten it.
A detective confronts a visitor with forensic typewriter evidence, locks the door, and exposes his cruel scheme to impersonate his stepdaughter's suitor for money.
Detectives arrive at a country house, breach a barricaded room, find the captive gone, discover a ladder on the roof, confront the villain, and shoot an attacking dog to save him.
Two investigators examine a locked-room murder scene, scrutinizing the victims' bodies and the disordered chamber for overlooked clues.
A detective sums up a murder analysis, identifies a swarthy seaman as suspect, puzzles over his absence, and outlines an investigative plan tracing a boat and rudder to catch the killer.

A detective explains to his companion why an ordinary-seeming murder case is more intricate than a bizarre one, warning that the prefect cannot be trusted and the first priority must be verifying the corpse's identity with the missing woman.
A brilliant detective confronts a trembling thief with stolen evidence, extracts a confession, and offers a choice between ruin and mercy.
A merciful detective releases a penitent thief, dismissing the case to save a soul rather than serve the law.
A detective reveals he expects a suspect to arrive imminently and arms his companion for a potential confrontation.

A visitor arrives at a detective's rooms and finds him studying a battered hat, learns how a commissionaire retrieved it and a goose from a street altercation, watches the detective point out identifying initials, fails to deduce anything himself, and finally asks the detective for his own conclusions.
A detective and his companion examine two connected bedrooms, discovering a dummy bell-pull, a false ventilator, a clamped bed, and other suspicious modifications suggesting a murder mechanism.
The detective explains his ruse to his companion, revealing how a staged fire alarm compelled the target to betray the photograph's hiding place.
A detective analyzes contradictory witness testimony about voices to deduce the killer's non-human nature.

Over lunch, a detective explains his deductions to his companion, revealing how an Australian cry and a dying man's fragmented word identified the murderer's origin, then details how physical evidence at the scene exposed the killer's handedness, lameness, and habits.

A detective reviews a sensational murder case where newspapers advance competing theories about a missing woman's fate, challenge forensic evidence, and shift suspicion between suspects and investigators.
A consulting detective demonstrates the physical impossibility of the alleged theft by testing the coronet's durability and noting the suspect's bare feet.
The detective explains his reasoning process, revealing how he deduced the murder method and acknowledging his role in the outcome.

A brilliant detective examines a murder scene, tracks footprints through reeds and woods, deduces the killer's physical traits and habits from minute evidence, and confronts a skeptical police inspector with the solution.

A detective refutes the theory of multiple attackers by dismissing the surgeon's inference, arguing struggle traces indicate a lone assailant, and constructing a psychological profile of a terrified solitary murderer who flees leaving evidence behind versus a confident gang that would remove all traces.
A detective reflects on fate's cruelty after a dying murderer's confession secures an innocent man's acquittal, and the victims' children may find happiness unaware of their fathers' sins.

r-spec2-08.summary: A soldier in the trenches waits for the order to advance. When the whistle blows he charges across open ground into the guns.

candidates.summary: Before the duel can begin, Sioux warriors attack the moving train, prompting a desperate battle until a servant detaches the engine and brings the cars to safety near a fort.

A drunk soldier threatens a young intellectual, a ghostly crone urges his removal, a protector tries to lead him away, the soldier strikes him unconscious, and a crowd gathers as the protector shields the fallen man.
A detective reveals he expects a suspect to arrive imminently and arms his companion for a potential confrontation.
A soldier challenges a drunk intellectual before a surreal monarch, prompting a defiant speech about country and life before friends intervene.
Police arrive to break up the disturbance, a witness identifies the soldier as the aggressor, and comrades drag the belligerent soldier away cursing authority.

A woman recounts a young socialite's romantic history from a chance meeting with a soldier through a turbulent marriage to a wealthy man and a recent revelation linking the soldier to a mysterious neighbor.
A violent storm delays the steamer twenty-four hours while the master watches with calm, the detective calculates the delay's advantage, and the servant battles the elements helplessly.
A detective's companion waits for his return, then hears how the detective infiltrated a target's household, followed a couple to a church, and unwittingly witnessed their secret marriage.
A traveler vows to return for a duel over an insult, then learns the street violence was merely a minor election before departing by train.
A consulting detective and his companion confront the goose's owner, test his knowledge of the gem, and learn the bird came from a pub's goose club supplied by a Covent Garden salesman.

A mock-heroic farewell ceremony for a departing man erupts into violence when an agitator hurls a tin at him, misses, and the target escapes in a carriage chased by a dog, culminating in a mock-apotheosis.

A messenger dozes in a crowded passage until a surging crowd carries him to the courtroom door where a banker hands him a paper reading acquitted, and he departs the courthouse as the throng pours into the street.
The sailor arrives to claim his orangutan, but the detective springs a trap, confronting him with the murders until terror breaks him and honor compels a confession.
A storm-tossed steamer races toward a distant port while a servant frets over delays and a detective questions his master's purpose.
A mutineer secretly crafts a weapon to kill his officer at the helm, but an unexpected intervention prevents the murder.
A captain relents and orders the hold searched, revealing sound casks and requiring deeper excavation that leaves the ship top-heavy and vulnerable.
A whaling ship's frantic preparations accelerate while the absent captain's delayed arrival fuels the narrator's suppressed misgivings.
A whaling crew ignites the try-works at night, rendering blubber amid fire and foul smoke while the burning ship drives through dark seas like a vessel from hell.

A week after the Bastille's fall, a female leader and her lieutenant receive news that a hated official lives and has been captured, igniting a frenzied mob—especially women—to demand his blood and dismemberment in the Paris streets.
A traveler decides to rescue a captured companion, secures a volunteer escort from an officer, and departs with a promised reward while a detective chooses to remain behind.

r-spec2-09.summary: A grieving widow visits her husband's grave each morning. One day she finds a stranger there who knew him, and learns a secret that reshapes her memory.

candidates.summary: A wealthy widower details his household staff and troubled family to a consulting detective, describing a wayward son corrupted by a dangerous friend and a virtuous adopted daughter who refuses the son's proposals.
A mourner observes a burial at a cemetery, counts the mourners, notices an unknown thirteenth attendee, and drifts through memories of dead kin and burial customs as the grave is filled.
A regretful woman reflects on her rejected suitor, realizing too late her love for him while lamenting her sister's scandalous marriage.
A grieving widow petitions a passing aristocrat for a grave marker for her starved husband, but is coldly rebuffed and left behind.
Tom weaponizes intimate memories to prove Daisy's enduring attachment, shattering Gatsby's demand for total renunciation and prompting Daisy to admit she loved them both.
A disturbed widower walks through towns, vanishes for hours, then appears at a wealthy neighbor's estate seeking its owner.

Inside a mortuary chapel a priest intones the Latin rite while a mourner's thoughts turn irreverent and anatomical, then the coffin is borne outside where a widower weeps at a monument and companions critique the service.

A bride who fled her wedding confronts her abandoned groom and a detective, revealing she recognized her presumed-dead first husband at the altar and recounting their secret marriage, his survival, and their reunion.
A grieving widower in a garage confronts evidence of his wife's infidelity and becomes convinced her death was murder.
A woman's aunt is distracted by revisiting childhood haunts, while the young woman reflects on a gentleman's unexpected civility and invitation.

A mourning man encounters an acquaintance on the street, exchanges news of family and a recent funeral, endures her domestic complaints about a cryptic postcard and her husband's lawsuit, and observes her shabby appearance while hunger gnaws at him.
A solitary man on a beach reflects on recent deaths, watches a young woman, and lets his thoughts drift through memory, desire, and bodily discomfort.
A sparse funeral procession moves through rain to a graveside where only a handful of mourners gather, including a stranger who knew the deceased only through his books.

A widower collapses from fever, crawls to his wife's corpse, tallies his successive losses, considers the peril facing his father and brother, and attempts a lake crossing but finds himself unable to row.

A catechistic narrator calculates shifting age ratios across decades, recounts two childhood encounters, traces a widow's connection through a hotel, describes pushing her in a bathchair, and contrasts her final memories.

A funeral carriage passes a fallen leader's grave while a solitary mourner drifts through the cemetery, his mind weaving together burial customs, childhood memories, and bodily decay before a brief social encounter prompts his retreat.
A pursuer dreams of dead loved ones, reads taunting messages from his quarry, endures worsening polar conditions, and reaches a frozen ocean where he thanks his guiding spirit.
The stranger views the corpse and recognizes his murdered friend Henry Clerval, collapsing in horror and guilt.

A young woman returns from a walk to face her family's casual questions while concealing a life-changing secret, enduring a quiet evening of silent tension between acknowledged and unacknowledged lovers.
The stranger agrees to tell his cautionary tale to the eager captain, who resolves to record it faithfully.

r-spec2-10.summary: A revolution erupts in the city square. The crowd storms the palace gates, and a young idealist raises the banner as the guards open fire.

candidates.summary: A revolutionary mob arms itself in the streets, surges toward the Bastille, and after hours of fierce fighting breaches the fortress gates.
A revolutionary leader is carried into the captured fortress, seizes a jailer, and forces him to reveal a specific prisoner's cell in the North Tower.
A provincial road-mender travels with a revolutionary couple to a royal pageant, succumbs to monarchist fervor, then discovers his performance was cultivated to inflame aristocratic complacency.
A band of revolutionaries sets a noble estate ablaze while villagers watch and authorities refuse to intervene, leaving the building to burn completely.
A revolutionary mob storms a government hall, seizes a hated official, drags him through streets, and hangs him from a lamp post after a brutal public torture.
Armed revolutionaries burst in to arrest a former aristocrat, while his father-in-law demands answers and learns the denunciation comes from a wine-shop keeper and his wife.
A sudden storm breaks a long drought, driving pedestrians into a tavern where drinkers converse while a woman labors upstairs, ending with a prophecy of fire to come.

Revolutionary leaders vote to register a noble chateau and its entire lineage for extermination, debate the security of their knitted register, and decide to keep a peasant witness alive to display him before royalty as bait.

A dying man envisions his enemies perishing by the same instrument, a new city rising from revolution's abyss, his loved ones prospering in England, his legacy enduring through generations, and his namesake becoming an honored judge who tells his story.

Despite a physician's persistent efforts, revolutionary justice overwhelms individual mercy as a king falls, a republic rises in blood, mass conscription sweeps the land, suspect laws fill prisons, and a mechanical guillotine becomes the terrifying new deity.
A revolutionary couple returns through night to their quarter, passes a murdered noble's estate where stone visages bear witness, then catalogs an English infiltrator for future retribution.
An apocalyptic vision unfolds with Dublin burning, historical Irish leaders dueling, a blasphemous black mass celebrated over a naked goddess, and divine voices pronouncing judgment.
Three years of revolution engulf France as a child grows in peaceful exile while the aristocracy flees and the monarchy collapses.

A crowd in a city square watches a bizarre balloon made of newspapers descend from the clouds, carrying a strange little man in a hat-car, and recognizes the hat as belonging to a long-missing townsman.
A chaotic crowd gathers at a slum entrance where marginal figures enact nightly rituals until violence erupts and a young woman sings while soldiers mock passing intellectuals.
A thunderstorm terrifies a braggart in a tavern, prompting mockery, failed rationalization, and an allegorical vision of divine wrath against sinners.

A week after the Bastille's fall, a female leader and her lieutenant receive news that a hated official lives and has been captured, igniting a frenzied mob—especially women—to demand his blood and dismemberment in the Paris streets.

A revolutionary mob captures the Bastille's governor, marches him through Paris streets to the Hotel de Ville, where a woman beheads him, then hoists severed heads as lamps while parading freed prisoners, as the narrator dreads the revolution's bloody footsteps reaching an innocent woman.
A loyal guardian confronts a vengeful revolutionary at a locked door, grapples with her in a desperate struggle, and kills her when she draws a pistol.

A destitute Parisian district suffers under pervasive hunger that marks every dwelling and scrap, while suppressed rage simmers among the starving populace and weapons alone gleam amid the squalor, foreshadowing revolutionary violence.
